---
name: Feature Request
about: Something the site should do and does not
labels: enhancement
---

**Anything large is worth a discussion first.**

### What are you trying to do

The task, not the feature. "I want to check whether a room is free before
walking there" tells us more than "add a filter".

### What would you like to happen

### What you do today instead

Whatever you currently use, even if it is a screenshot in your notes app. It
usually shows what the feature actually has to beat.

### Anything else

Screenshots, links to how another site does it, or a mod code where it matters.
